headline: New SKHS project: Discussion and action on recommending FFE package to Town Council, plus Curtis Corner updates.
summary: The meeting covers updates on the New SKHS project and a possible recommendation on its FFE package. It also includes updates on move management, the Hazard Building envelope, and Curtis Corner.
